name: god-rays
title: God Rays
description: High-performance procedural god rays effect with customizable colors, pulsating intensity, and distortion. Lit Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/god-rays-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-god-rays
    color="#FFFFFF"
    background-color="#17181A"
    :anchor-x="0.5"
    :anchor-y="1.2"
    :direction-x="0"
    :direction-y="-1"
    :speed="1"
    :light-spread="1"
    :ray-length="1"
    :pulsating="false"
    :fade-distance="1"
    :saturation="1"
    :noise-amount="0"
    :distortion="0"
    :intensity="1"
    class="w-full h-[500px]"
  />
</template>

<motion-god-rays
  color="#FFFFFF"

  anchor-y="1.2"

  direction-y="-1"
  speed="1"
  light-spread="1"
  ray-length="1"

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the god rays light source.

props.name: anchor-x
props.description: X position of the light source (0-1 range).

props.name: anchor-y
props.description: Y position of the light source (can be outside 0-1 range).

props.name: direction-x
props.description: X component of the ray direction vector.

props.name: direction-y
props.description: Y component of the ray direction vector (downward).

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed of the ray shimmer.

props.name: light-spread
props.description: How much the light spreads from the source.

props.name: pulsating
props.description: Whether the rays pulsate over time.

props.name: fade-distance
props.description: Distance at which rays fade out.

props.name: saturation
props.description: Color saturation of the rays (1 = full, 0 = grayscale).

props.name: noise-amount
props.description: Amount of noise variation in the rays.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall brightness and intensity of the rays.
